notes.title: Major Version 1.12
notes.content:
Major Update for Version 1.12 is now live!

Showcase Trailer: 
[previewyoutube=yhZSJSJS2_Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Major Graphical Update[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/3f734060c8c9692d3bcefd7bb0cf0cb8c536e75e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/ca54473e7bdaf9ad5be6dba5ab961c9e295f9236.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/fbf005ef3241e7ee9795a52a84c4f79d436e0432.png[/img]

[b]Reactor Map Redesign[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/80a1869b8e998db633382788421b452ee328b142.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/7ecf7a8eab4ff84a24f37caca9f9b6744ce3918b.jpg[/img]

[Version 1.12.0]
	- Major graphical improvements and technical optimisations for all maps
	- Complete Reactor map redesign
	- Two and Four player maps have been merged
	- Automatic weapon fire rate is no longer affected by poor latency
	- Player and Bot spawn points are now random
	- Players now explode on death
	- 4 Player matches are now default for all maps
	- Players now take damage if they wait too long inside the spawn rooms
	- Added "Pigeon Mode" Extra Option
	- Added Smoke Beam
	- Added Slam Jump Ability
	- Added Dash Pads that grant an additional dash for the round
	- Extra Settings no longer make games private
	- Improved Bot behaviour
	  	> Improved overall pathfinding & behaviour
		> Bots now maintain different distances dependent on weapon type
		> Bots now utilise Gunslinger ability
		> Bots now recognise the Player's Invisibility
	- Added Crosshair hitmarker and sound
	- Added bullet lock-on for most weapon types
		> Auto - 0.15 lock
		> Burst - 0.2 lock
		> Semi-Auto - 0.3 lock
		> Single - 0.35 lock
		> Shotgun - 0.2 lock
	- Added window Resolution Settings
	- Added FoV slider
	- Added Credits
	- Added successful stun indicator
	- Increased all secondary damage (*2)
	- Increased Laser Beam lock-on radius
	- Increased all Secondary damage radius
	- Increased Sonic Beam force (200 -> 250)
	- Increased Stun Beam duration (0.75 -> 0.8)
	- Increased overall weapon viewmodel kickback
	- Increased Shotgun Pellet count (5 -> 6)
	- Increased PPSH damage (3 -> 4)
	- Increased E-SMG damage (2 -> 3)
	- Decreased E-SMG ammo count (24 -> 18)
	- Decreased E-Shotgun damage (5 -> 4)
	- Decreased Spas-12 damage (4 -> 3)
	- Removed Explosive Beam lock-on
	- Removed Short Circuit Status Effect	
	- Improved player board UI
	- Main Menu UI improvements
	- Remastered Main Menu soundtrack
	- Status effects now have descriptions
	- Round Results simplified
	- Overall performance improvements
	- Shotgun Crosshair now has a dot to help aim secondaries
	- Toughness no longer allows 0 damage
	- Disconnect button now permanently enabled
	- Hitting player arms now deals the same damage as torso
	- Fixed bug resulting in players not being able to reconnect correctly
	- Fixed certain stuck-spots and OOB exploits
	- Fixed missing texture on Rocket Silo
	- Fixed exploit allowing players to shoot faster than the intended fire rate
	- Fixed bug resulting in Damage Indicator disappearing too quick
	- Fixed bug resulting in Automatic weapons stopping when missing a shot
	- Fixed bug resulting in certain achievements becoming unattainable
	- Fixed bug allowing players to occasionally shoot while dead
	- Fixed bug resulting in game window launching in a huge resolution
	- Fixed bug preventing Windowed Borderless
	- Fixed bug allowing player weapons to be seen through walls
	- Fixed bug preventing the pause menu opening while dead
	- Fixed viewmodel clipping into walls after using Invisibility visual bug

Thank you.

notes.title: Major Version 1.11.0
notes.content:
Update for Version 1.11.0 is now live!
Introducing the new Reactor Map, alongside Special Rounds, Status Effects and a new Weapon series!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/6ebfd8caa5ff52ca4de9958056d0c72f90638dd8.png[/img]
[b]New Reactor Map[/b] - A new four-player map situated in the facility's dark nuclear power generation plant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/7905b4e281e402b55621951a73bf22b3fafe4131.png[/img]
[b]New Weapon Series[/b] - 3 new weapons themed around the machinery found around the new map location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/301e89a688dc850f782993d006b2865d097faccf.png[/img]
[b]Special Rounds & Status Effects[/b] - New Status Effects are given to players every odd round (excluding the first.) The types of Status Effects are listed below.

[Version 1.11.0]
[list]
[*][b]Added E-Deagle
[*]Added E-Shotgun
[*]Added E-SMG
[*]Added Pigeon
[/b][*]Automatic & Burst weapons' now only randomise bullet spread horizontally
[*]Removed bullet spread randomisation on Pistols and Rifles
[*]Rebalanced various weapons
[*]Added Damage Dummies to the shooting range
[*][b]Added Status Effects[/b]
[*]> Burning - Deals 5 damage to the player over 3 seconds
[*]> Freezing - Deals 2 damage to the player over 3 seconds, prevents Dashing
[*]> Rusting - Deals 1 damage to the player over 3 seconds, prevents jumping
[*]> Short Circuit - Deals 1 damage to the player over 3 seconds, inverts movement controls
[*]> Power Surge - Deals 1 damage to the player over 3 seconds, prevents using Abilities
[*][b]Added Special Rounds[/b] - every odd round (excluding the first) all players' weapons are assigned a random status effect that affects the other player when hit
[*]Added fullscreen / windowed option in the settings menu
[*]Main Menu UI adjustments
[*]> Better organised "4 Player Map" text on map list
[*]> Added "No Special Rounds" Extra Option
[*]> Moved "Versus Bot" option to along the top
[*]> Added tooltips to remaining options along the top
[*]> Added tiny icons to the server listings
[*]> Updated Random Map showcase image
[*]Fixed texture on the moving cart in Rocket Silo
[*]Fixed weapons clipping into walls/level geometry graphical issue
[*]Fixed issue resulting in certain weapons doing 0 damage when hitting arms/legs
[/list]

Thank you.

notes.title: Version 1.10.0
notes.content:
Update for Version 1.10.0 is now Live!
Introducing a new map; the Bio-Dome. Host a game and have a go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/afa7bf7928b10f7b2fc3cf8affe109f1bc9d2c29.png[/img]
[b]The Bio-Dome[/b] - a new flat, simple and symmetrical map situated in a Combat Labs Bio-Dome on the surface. Features lush plant life and curved walls creating interesting angles and a fun arena to traverse around during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/a677016fffb5fd38227a23ebcbffccc78ee9f409.png[/img]
[b]Edited Playermodels[/b] - redesigned player character models to fit more in line with the game's overall graphical theme.
&
[b]Headshots / hit location damage multipliers[/b] - Damage is now dependent on where on the body your shot hits, headshots do the most damage, torso next, then arms and legs least.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/d080bc9d4ccec7dc7ad678ddf70b35f09e36482f.png[/img]

Thank you.

[Version 1.10.0]
[list]
[*][b]Added Bio-Dome map
[*]Damage is now affected by which body part was hit
[*]Updated player model to be more stylised
[/b][*]Added Jump Boost ability
[*]Removed Sharpshooter ability
[*]Added Bot support for forced 4 player maps
[*]Added sparks hit-marker when hitting opponent
[*]Added light indicators to targets behind cover in the Timed Target Range
[*]Added a high-score sound for the Shooting Range
[*]Decreased rate at which holograms spawn in the Aim Training
[*]Adjusted Bot spawn positions on some maps
[*]Secret door keypad code is now randomly generated
[*]Minor Bot behaviour improvements
[*]Minor Main Menu UI improvements
[*]Fixed Sonic beam not affecting Bots
[*]Fixed bug resulting in a Bot being spawned in the Shooting Range
[*]Fixed bug allowing abilities to be used infinitely after changing loadout
[/list]

[Known issues in this Patch]
[list]
[*]Bots sometimes don't initiate correctly - especially on FloodTunnels and very rarely on other maps.
[*]Bots do not immediately exit the spawn area on certain maps - especially on Rocket Silo, however they can be lured out when they see you.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Version 1.9.0
notes.content:
Update for Version 1.9.0 is now live!
Introducing Ai Bots and massive Shooting Range expansions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/1a72bb619acab1a8ddef12daba3107f0fc73a79d.png[/img]
[b]BOT Support for all Maps[/b] - fight against difficult Ai opponents in an offline match on any map. Practice your movement, aiming, abilities and combat skills against a clever and relentless foe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/c4d31b79c594d79dbe849ae7553eb3b56c8b1c76.png[/img]
[b]New Timed Target Range[/b] - traverse around a short target range course in which you must shoot all targets and reach the end. Practice movement and fast-paced aiming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/6875a2196c816e7d774dc7aa98a04bb2e9fbe561.png[/img]
[b]New Hologram Aim Training[/b] - standoff against increasing numbers of hologram targets. Practice aiming and managing reloads in frantic combat.

Screenshot and upload your times to Steam to compare with other players.

[Version 1.9.0]
[list]
[*][b]Added Ai / Bot opponents - selected from the Host Game [i]Extras Menu[/i] under the "Versus Bot" option
[*]Shooting Range expansions - timed target range and hologram aim training
[/b][*]Added tooltips to the Extra Settings options
[*]Lowered the spawn rooms to floor level on Mineral Mines
[*]Decreased splash screen volume
[*]Improved Disabler Beam reliability
[*]Lost the passcode for the door at the back of the shooting range
[*]Fixed graphical bug on the Host Game menu
[/list]

Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40154051/e02fa2beb84b855847373e566691dfecfed6499d.png[/img]
DO NOT ENTER
